scenarios.title: Job interview
scenarios.role: A friendly hiring manager at a mid-sized software company, interviewing for a project coordinator role.
scenarios.learnerRole: A candidate for the project coordinator job.
scenarios.goal: Introduce yourself, give one example of solving a problem at work, and ask one question about the team.
usefulPhrases: What I learned from that was ...
Could you tell me more about ...?
scenarios.opening: Thanks for coming in today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself and what you do now?

scenarios.title: Team meeting
scenarios.role: A team lead running a short weekly meeting about a delayed product launch.
scenarios.learnerRole: A team member responsible for testing.
scenarios.goal: Give a short update, explain one problem, and suggest a next step.
scenarios.opening: Okay, let's get started. Could you give us a quick update on testing?
